fact: Times of Eswatini reports a national e-KYC system, set to roll out soon, to digitise identity verification for financial services, with commercial banks, financial service providers, regulators and ministries meeting to coordinate implementation of the national e-KYC registry and the Royal Science and Technology Park providing the infrastructure for a national identity verification platform; the article does not say the platform checks against the national ID database.

APC states that recent developments allow service providers such as commercial banks to access the civil registry for identity verification, while saying the National ID card does not yet meet the criteria for digital identification.
system: civil registry access for commercial banks
source_slug: 2024-07-22 Risk of human rights infringement as Eswatini rushes to regulate the ICT sector

fact: Banks and other financial institutions verify customer identification information against the national civil registry through the national database centre, per the Central Bank Deputy Governor.
system: digital verification of identification via the national database centre

fact: Financial institutions are integrated with the national database centre (Eswatini Royal Science Technology Park) to verify customers' ID information against the national civil registry, per the Central Bank of Eswatini's Deputy Governor.
system: National database centre ID verification (Eswatini Royal Science Technology Park)
